💷 Andy Burnham wants to replace inheritance tax with a "national care levy" — and says the Government "might be having to ask for a little more."

Strip away the branding. A levy on what you leave behind when you die is a DEATH TAX. And it won't hit the super-rich with their trusts and accountants — it'll hit the ordinary family whose main asset is the home they spent a lifetime paying off.

Reform UK would not tax people for dying. Protect the family home, fund care by cutting government waste, and be honest that "a little more" always means working Britain paying more.

Read the full piece 👇
